problems.problem: The J.C. Bose Fellowship is for senior scientists with a proven track record; only the Ramanujan Fellowship targets early‑career researchers returning to India.
problems.correction: The Ramanujan Fellowship targets early‑career researchers returning to India; the J.C. Bose Fellowship supports senior scientists with proven track records
problems.verifierReason: J.C. Bose Fellowship is for senior scientists; Ramanujan Fellowship targets early‑career returnees.

problems.quote: gravity falls by roughly 0.3 % per kilometre of altitude near the surface
problems.problem: The fractional decrease in gravitational acceleration per kilometre of altitude is about 0.031%, not 0.3%. The binomial expansion gives g ≈ g₀(1 – 2h/Rₑ), so the relative change per km is 2/Rₑ ≈ 2/6371 ≈ 0.000314 = 0.0314%.
problems.correction: gravity falls by roughly 0.03 % per kilometre of altitude near the surface
problems.verifierReason: Original 0.3% is 10x too high; binomial approx 2/6371 km = 0.0314%/km. Correction 0.03% is accurate rounding.

problems.quote: regardless of whether the force is constant or variable
problems.problem: The derivation explicitly assumes a constant force (W = F s) and uses the constant-acceleration kinematic equation v_f² = v_i² + 2 a s. It does not demonstrate the work-energy theorem for variable forces; the general proof requires integration of F·dr.
problems.verifierReason: The derivation using W=Fs and v²=u²+2as assumes constant force/acceleration; it does not prove the theorem for variable forces which requires integration.
